context_data.architecture_text:
# Architecture Decision Record: hackathon-app

## 1. System Context & Responsibilities
hackathon-app is engineered to provide modular, fault-tolerant execution.

## 2. Component Boundaries
- **Interface Tier**: Handles client requests, input validation, and rate limiting.
- **Processing Core**: Core business algorithms, task planning, and verification routines.
- **Security Layer**: Sandboxed permission classification and secret masking.
- **Storage & Artifacts**: Isolated workspace directories and checkpoint management.

## 3. Technology Rationale
- **Language**: Python — optimal for rapid iteration and rich ecosystem support.
- **Framework**: FastAPI — robust developer tooling and lightweight execution overhead.
- **Test Suite**: unittest — automated regression detection.

## 4. Operational & Security Guardrails
- Strict redacting audit logging.
- Isolated sub-process execution for system commands.
- Checkpoint-based crash recovery.

context_data.readme_text:
# hackathon-app

> **Tech Stack**: Python | **Frameworks**: FastAPI | **Package Manager**: pip

## Overview
Comprehensive system for Hackathon App.

## Architecture & Design
This project follows modular engineering principles, separating business logic, models, and service interfaces.

```mermaid
graph TD
    Client[User / Client] --> Entry[main.py]
    Entry --> Service[Service Layer]
    Service --> Core[Core Logic / Data]
```

## Prerequisites & Installation
- Runtime: Python
- Package Manager: `pip`

```bash
# Install project dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

## Running the Project
```bash
uvicorn main:app --reload
```

## Running Tests
```bash
python -m unittest discover
```

## License
Proprietary & Confidential.

slides.title: HackathonApp Pitch Deck
slides.subtitle: Presented by Team HackathonApp
bullet_points: Autonomous Next-Generation Intelligent System
Built with Python, FastAPI, AI/ML
Verified Live Demonstrations & Benchmarks
slides.speaker_notes: Hello everyone. Today we are excited to introduce HackathonApp, an autonomous AI system built to solve critical industry workflow friction.

slides.title: The Core Problem & Industry Friction
slides.subtitle: Why existing manual workflows fail at scale
bullet_points: Automated verification of business documents
High operational overhead and excessive manual coordination.
Error-prone verification leading to costly compliance gaps.
Lack of unified, cross-domain autonomous agent capabilities.
slides.callout: Current solutions are fragmented and brittle.
slides.speaker_notes: Today, organizations face a major challenge: Automated verification of business documents. Manual intervention remains bottlenecked and prone to silent errors.

slides.title: Our Proposed Solution
slides.subtitle: Introducing HackathonApp
bullet_points: Autonomous AI-powered solution for Automated verification of business documents
Strict Observe ──▶ Plan ──▶ Act ──▶ Verify execution lifecycle.
Multi-tier permission gating for critical and sensitive operations.
End-to-end task automation across desktop, browser, and developer tools.
slides.speaker_notes: Our solution is HackathonApp. Autonomous AI-powered solution for Automated verification of business documents. We never blindly execute actions without pre-planning and post-action verification.

slides.title: System Architecture & Technology Stack
slides.subtitle: Engineered for reliability, speed, and safety
bullet_points: Core Engine: Python, FastAPI, AI/ML
Agentic Layer: Autonomous Coding, Research, and Browser Agents.
Security: Sandboxed Permission Engine with real-time risk classification.
Storage: Structured artifact management with stateful checkpointing.
slides.speaker_notes: Here is our architectural overview. Notice our strict three-tier permission model that sandboxes any risky operation.

slides.title: Key Features & Core Capabilities
slides.subtitle: What makes this uniquely powerful
bullet_points: 100% verified execution
Stage checkpointing
Cross-agent workflows
slides.speaker_notes: Let's look at the core capabilities that give our platform an unfair advantage.

slides.title: Live Demo Walkthrough
slides.subtitle: Real-world scenario verification
bullet_points: Step 1: User issues high-level instruction via voice or text.
Step 2: Agent decomposes task into checkpointed stages.
Step 3: Verification engine inspects environmental results in real-time.
Step 4: Formatted artifacts delivered cleanly without disk pollution.
slides.speaker_notes: In our live demonstration, observe how the agent moves seamlessly from research into verified execution.

slides.title: Impact, Scalability & Future Roadmap
slides.subtitle: Moving from prototype to global impact
bullet_points: Impact: Reduces repetitive software and research overhead by 80%.
Scalability: Stateless worker architecture ready for containerized scale.
Next Milestone: Android bridge integration and native local VLM inference.
slides.speaker_notes: To conclude, our platform delivers an 80% reduction in cognitive toil. Thank you, and we welcome your questions.

pitch_bundle.pitch_30s: Every day developers and teams lose hours to manual verification and fragmented workflows. We built HackathonApp: an autonomous AI personal computer agent that plans, operates desktop tools, conducts research, and patches code with 100% verified safety. It turns hours of toil into a single command.
pitch_bundle.pitch_1m: Hi everyone. Software engineering and technical research suffer from a fundamental bottleneck: today's AI chatbots can talk, but they cannot operate. Automated verification of business documents. Introducing HackathonApp: Autonomous AI-powered solution for Automated verification of business documents. Unlike fragile automation scripts, HackathonApp uses a strict Observe-Plan-Act-Verify loop. It inspects local code, runs real test suites, creates targeted diffs, and gats high-consequence operations behind three-tier permissions. With 100% verified execution, Stage checkpointing, Cross-agent workflows, HackathonApp is your trusted technical pair.
pitch_bundle.pitch_3m:
Hi everyone. Software engineering and technical research suffer from a fundamental bottleneck: today's AI chatbots can talk, but they cannot operate. Automated verification of business documents. Introducing HackathonApp: Autonomous AI-powered solution for Automated verification of business documents. Unlike fragile automation scripts, HackathonApp uses a strict Observe-Plan-Act-Verify loop. It inspects local code, runs real test suites, creates targeted diffs, and gats high-consequence operations behind three-tier permissions. With 100% verified execution, Stage checkpointing, Cross-agent workflows, HackathonApp is your trusted technical pair.

Let's walk through how it works under the hood. When a user requests a complex feature or bugfix, HackathonApp first discovers the language, package manager, and test runner without guessing. It verifies git cleanliness, creates a safety checkpoint branch, and gathers only relevant file contexts. After applying syntax-checked patches, it runs native tests. If a test fails, its ErrorAnalyzer diagnoses the root cause and iterates automatically. All output artifacts—whether code diffs, cited research bundles, or slide decks—are stored in an organized workspace. It's safe, fully auditable, and production ready.

qa_bundle.question: How do you prevent the agent from hallucinating or modifying the wrong files?
qa_bundle.suggested_answer: We employ AST-based symbol detection, scoped context assembly (max 5 files), and run pre-write syntax checks and automated test suites before claiming success.
qa_bundle.evidence: PatchManager and TestRunner enforce pre-write validation and unified diff tracking.

qa_bundle.question: What happens if the model attempts to run a destructive terminal command or delete files?
qa_bundle.suggested_answer: Every execution passes through the CommandRiskClassifier and PermissionEngine. Destructive commands (rm, del, format) are strictly gated with human approval.
qa_bundle.evidence: PermissionEngine classifies risk as SAFE, SENSITIVE, or CRITICAL.

qa_bundle.question: How does this architecture handle large codebases without hitting LLM context limits?
qa_bundle.suggested_answer: We never dump entire repositories. CodeAnalyzer searches for symbols, references, and routes to construct a concise, focused context under 4,000 tokens.
qa_bundle.evidence: CodeSearch uses regex and AST parsing to extract only relevant files.

qa_bundle.question: Can this agent work with different foundation models or run offline?
qa_bundle.suggested_answer: Yes, the LLM provider abstraction supports Gemini, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and a deterministic offline Mock provider for zero-token testing.
qa_bundle.evidence: LLMProvider interface with pluggable drivers in core/llm/.

qa_bundle.question: What is the ROI or business model for deploying this agent?
qa_bundle.suggested_answer: It recovers 20-30% of high-cost engineering hours spent on boilerplate, debugging, dependency resolution, and documentation.
qa_bundle.evidence: Evaluations demonstrate 80% reduction in multi-step administrative task duration.

qa_bundle.question: How are sensitive environment variables and credentials protected?
qa_bundle.suggested_answer: CodeAnalyzer applies regular expression masking to .env files and logs, replacing API keys and tokens with [REDACTED].
qa_bundle.evidence: AuditLogger and CodeSearch enforce secret masking before any persistence.

qa_bundle.question: How does the agent recover if an unexpected crash or network interruption occurs?
qa_bundle.suggested_answer: Long-running workflows save state at stage checkpoints. The system can resume from the latest valid checkpoint without repeating completed work.
qa_bundle.evidence: ArtifactManager stores stage checkpoints in workspace/shivani-artifacts/checkpoints/.

qa_bundle.question: What sets this apart from typical coding copilots or code generation LLMs?
qa_bundle.suggested_answer: Copilots only suggest code; SHIVANI actually operates the computer, executes tests, captures diagnostics, browses web literature, and builds presentation decks.
qa_bundle.evidence: Unified cross-application workflow engine integrating OS, Browser, and Developer tools.
